backend-architect.description: Use this agent when you need expert guidance on backend architecture decisions, domain modeling, microservices design, event-driven system architecture, or when refactoring complex business logic in Node.js/TypeScript applications. Examples include designing bounded contexts for a new feature, evaluating event sourcing strategies, reviewing aggregate design, planning service decomposition, or architecting inter-service communication patterns.

backend-engineer.description: Use this agent to implement backend services, API endpoints, domain models, and tests following DDD, EDA, and microservices patterns. Handles code implementation, refactoring, test writing, and architectural reviews for distributed backend systems.

ddd-reviewer.description: Use this agent to REVIEW code changes for Domain-Driven Design and layering correctness: aggregate boundaries, invariants enforced inside entities, inward-pointing dependencies, repository interfaces vs concrete classes, mappers, DTOs at boundaries, and ubiquitous language. Use PROACTIVELY after backend domain changes and as the DDD seat of the council skill. Read-only. Not for designing new boundaries (backend-architect) or general code review (principal-engineer).

devops-engineer.description: Use this agent when you need practical, production-ready DevOps guidance to design, automate, and operate infrastructure, including IaC, CI/CD pipelines, containers and Kubernetes, cloud architecture, reliability and scaling, and day-2 operations with strong observability and security.

e2e-test-engineer.description: Use this agent to create, review, or debug Playwright end-to-end tests: new E2E suites, flaky test diagnosis and fixes, CI configuration for E2E runs, and test architecture (fixtures, page objects, organization).

frontend-architect.description: Use this agent to define frontend technical strategy: application structure, state management architecture, data flow, rendering strategy, API integration layers, and performance strategy. Decides how the frontend is built and hands implementation to frontend-engineer. Not for writing component code or visual design.

frontend-engineer.description: Use this agent to implement frontend code: React/Next.js/React Native components, styling from design tokens, hooks, client-side data fetching, and unit/integration tests. Use for writing or fixing UI code. Does NOT choose architecture, state libraries, or visual design.

principal-engineer.description: Use this agent to REVIEW existing code, designs, or architecture at a senior level: code reviews, design reviews, and risk assessment of proposed changes. Returns a verdict with severity-ranked findings. Chairs the council skill and rules when two agents disagree. For designing new solutions or migration plans use staff-engineer instead.

secops-auditor.description: Use this agent when you need expert security operations guidance, security architecture review, or threat analysis for microservices-based systems. Invoke this agent if user is developing a new API gateway for a microservices architecture and needs security validation.

seo-inspector.description: Use this agent to audit, design, and improve SEO for modern websites and web applications. It covers technical SEO, content architecture, Core Web Vitals, structured data, internationalization, AI search readiness, and future-facing discoverability patterns for both classic search engines and answer engines.

staff-engineer.description: Use this agent to DESIGN solutions for complex or cross-cutting technical problems: system design options, migration and refactoring plans, technical standards, and trade-off analysis spanning multiple teams or services. For reviewing existing code or designs use principal-engineer instead.

ux-ui-architect.description: Use this agent for visual and interaction design decisions: design systems, design tokens, component blueprints, user flows, accessibility specs, and Figma design extraction. Not for writing functional code, choosing frameworks, or state management.
